mathematics.assertion_tested: A rank-one trace/lapse/U kinetic completion preserves static response and has a single regular scalar pole; its conserved planar-source tidal contact cancels only on E r^2=zeta(r-s)^2.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Exact real rational functions with complex Fourier i
mathematics.conventions: k=1 by homogeneous rescaling, q=omega^2/k^2; derivative=-i omega; source=-R phi+Rdot beta-stress psi with stress=qR; tidal=-k^2(phi+betadot)-omega^2 psi
inputs: Three-field static quadratic form and rank-one trace/lapse/U velocities
General real E,zeta,r,s,B on regular branch

bounds.exclusions: k=0, E=2, zeta=0, D=0, B=0, kappa<=0

non_claims: No full action DOF or PPN certification
No universal obstruction from exact law after independent G normalization
